modules.title: Everyday medicinal plants
modules.activity: Connect familiar common names with scientific names and study materials.

modules.title: Phytochemical foundations
modules.activity: Match the selected study marker to a plant; separate material identity from efficacy.

modules.title: Clinical herbal products
modules.activity: Investigate product-specific evidence and challenge unsupported clinical claims.

modules.title: Pharmaceutical natural products
modules.activity: Trace the difference between a plant, an extract and a regulated medicine. Not every member has an approved drug.

modules.title: Toxicology & safety
modules.focus: Hazards, adverse effects and material distinctions
modules.activity: Recognize why identity, part, preparation and clinical context change risk. Membership is not a toxicity ranking.

modules.title: Gastrointestinal & Respiratory Medicinal Plants
modules.focus: Mucilage, aromatic materials and preparation-specific respiratory evidence
modules.activity: Compare traditional-use assessments with the well-established use of specific ivy-leaf preparations.

modules.title: Nervous System & Adaptogenic Plant Research
modules.focus: Constituent classes, study quality and liver safety
modules.activity: Separate anxiety, sleep and cognitive endpoints; critique evidence and preparation variability.

modules.title: Metabolic, Nutritional & Reproductive Plant Sciences
modules.activity: Compare food, supplements and specific extracts without transferring claims between plant parts.

modules.title: Dermatology, Inflammation & Botanical Quality
modules.activity: Distinguish species, route, plant part, contamination and conservation questions.

modules.title: Pharmaceutical Drug Sources & Toxicognosy
modules.focus: Recognition, mechanisms, clinical history and safety
modules.activity: Trace plant-to-medicine discovery and hazardous material distinctions. Recognition only; no preparation or administration.

modules.title: Advanced Alkaloids & Pharmaceutical Drug Sources
modules.focus: Alkaloid chemistry, biological targets and pharmaceutical sources
modules.activity: classify chemical structures, compare biological targets and distinguish medicinally useful compounds from hazardous plant materials.

modules.title: Terpenoids, Resins & Specialty Natural Products
modules.focus: Chemical variability, resins and botanical quality
modules.activity: compare simulated GC-MS fingerprints, investigate chemical variability and authenticate botanical materials.

modules.title: Glycosides, Phenolics & Advanced Phytochemistry
modules.focus: Constituent classes, authentication and evidence limits
modules.activity: classify metabolites and determine which analytical observations support botanical identity or product quality.

modules.title: Poisonous Medicinal Plants & Advanced Toxicognosy
modules.focus: Fictional exposure cases, recognition and referral
modules.activity: investigate fictional exposure cases, identify plant look-alikes, interpret clinical warning signs and select appropriate emergency referral decisions.

modules.title: Global Medicinal Heritage, Conservation & Advanced Research
modules.focus: Medicinal traditions, sustainable provenance and benefit sharing
modules.activity: Evaluate accepted names, provenance, traditional-knowledge attribution and benefit sharing.
